headline: PLAN THE WEEK.
body: Choose your training days before the week starts. Give each session a time and a place.
caption: Make your next session a calendar entry. Choose the day, time and location, then write down what you need to bring. A clear plan gives you one less decision to make. Save this for your next weekly reset. #TriValleyFit #TrainingConsistency

headline: MAKE IT REPEATABLE.
body: Build your schedule around the time you actually have. Leave room for real life.
caption: Your schedule should fit an ordinary week. Choose a routine you can repeat, then review what worked. A planner can help you spot the difference between a workable schedule and an optimistic one. #TriValleyFit #TrainingHabits

headline: LOG THE SESSION.
body: Record what you did, how it felt and one detail to remember next time.
caption: Keep your training notes simple: the session you completed, what felt manageable and what you want to revisit. These notes help you ask better questions and plan the next week. #TriValleyFit #WorkoutJournal

headline: HAVE A BACKUP.
body: If your original time falls through, choose a realistic alternative. Avoid trying to catch up all at once.
caption: A missed appointment does not have to erase your plan. Write down a backup time in advance. Adapt your schedule to your circumstances and any guidance from your coach. #TriValleyFit #PlanAhead

headline: TRACK FOLLOW-THROUGH.
body: Compare completed sessions with planned sessions. Use the result to improve the next plan.
caption: Try this weekly review: completed sessions divided by planned sessions, multiplied by 100. If you planned zero sessions, record N/A. Use the number as information about your plan, rather than a judgment about yourself. #TriValleyFit #WeeklyReview

headline: NOTICE THE PATTERN.
body: What helped you show up? What repeatedly got in the way? Change one thing for next week.
caption: Review the practical details: session timing, travel, equipment and competing commitments. Pick one adjustment you can test next week. Keep what helps and update what does not. #TriValleyFit #BuildConsistency

headline: REVIEW FOUR WEEKS.
body: Look back at your calendar and notes. Keep the useful habits. Set your next realistic target.
caption: Four weeks of notes can give you a clearer picture of your routine. What did you repeat? What needs a different approach? Choose one realistic goal for your next block. TriValley.fit - training with a plan. #TriValleyFit #TrainingPlanner
